risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operational and financing information, including revenue growth, operating losses, debt paydowns, and interest expense. Risk tone is moderately negative because the company remains loss-making and exposed to commodity volatility, inflation, interest rates, geopolitical events, and supply-chain disruption, although results improved year over year. Boilerplate disclaimers and non-GAAP exclusion of identified non-core expenses somewhat temper comparability and transparency.
